items.title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 3rd Season
items.description: In the aftermath of the Shi Clan's rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation." To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again. From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

items.title: Shiguang Dailiren III
items.description: After the Li Tianchen incident came to a close, Time Photo Studio returned to a superficial peace. However, the news of Xia Fei's disappearance once again drew everyone into a crossroads of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's awakening of her superpowers, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang gradually uncover the secrets of the Bahati fire case, and Cheng Xiaoshi's father, Cheng Weimin, and mother, Shao Yuanyuan, also seem to have intricate connections to it. As the investigation deepens, Liu Xiao from a mysterious organization begins his operation, and the intervention of Yingdu police officer Jae further complicates this pursuit of the truth...

items.title_es: Shiguang Dailiren III
items.description_es: Después de que el incidente de Li Tianchen llegó a su fin, Time Photo Studio volvió a una paz superficial. Sin embargo, la noticia de la desaparición de Xia Fei una vez más llevó a todos a una encrucijada del destino. Con el regreso de Vein y el despertar de sus superpoderes por parte de Qiao Ling, Cheng Xiaoshi y Lu Guang descubren gradualmente los secretos del caso del incendio de Bahati, y el padre de Cheng Xiaoshi, Cheng Weimin, y su madre, Shao Yuanyuan, también parecen tener conexiones intrincadas con él. A medida que la investigación se profundiza, Liu Xiao, de una organización misteriosa, comienza su operación, y la intervención del oficial de policía de Yingdu, Jae, complica aún más esta búsqueda de la verdad...

items.title: Sekiro: No Defeat
items.description: The time is Sengoku. Japan is fractured into many independent nations entangled in ceaseless war. At the center lies Ashina, a land of sacred earth and ancient mystery. Two decades after Sword Saint Isshin Ashina reclaimed the region in a brutal coup, a new threat emerges from within: The Interior Ministry. Desperate to protect his homeland, Isshin's grandson Gen'ichirou turns to forbidden powers. The only hope lies in a kidnapped boy—the Divine Heir—and his silent protector: a loyal shinobi known only as Sekiro. This is the story of a lord and his retainer—and their quest to restore balance to a nation on the edge.
items.title_japanese: SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT
items.title_es: Sekiro: Sin derrota
items.description_es: El tiempo es Sengoku. Japón está dividido en muchas naciones independientes enredadas en guerras incesantes. En el centro se encuentra Ashina, una tierra de tierra sagrada y misterio antiguo. Dos décadas después de que Sword Saint Isshin Ashina recuperara la región mediante un brutal golpe de estado, surge una nueva amenaza desde dentro: el Ministerio del Interior. Desesperado por proteger su tierra natal, el nieto de Isshin, Gen'ichirou, recurre a poderes prohibidos. La única esperanza reside en un niño secuestrado, el Heredero Divino, y su protector silencioso: un shinobi leal conocido sólo como Sekiro. Esta es la historia de un señor y su vasallo, y su búsqueda para restablecer el equilibrio en una nación al límite.

items.title: The Ribbon Hero
items.description: Sapphire is the princess of a kingdom that no longer exists. Having lost everything in her homeland of Silverland to the calamity known as "Nergal," she wanders in despair until she finally arrives in Goldland. Though burdened by her past, she begins to find a glimmer of hope as she encounters the kindness of the people there. But as if to sneer at her peaceful new life, the calamity Nergal appears once more. The very despair that once reduced her homeland to ashes now threatens to steal the light from this land as well. "I won't lose anything ever again. And I won't let anyone else lose anything either." Brushing away her tears of sorrow, the girl takes up her sword. This is the story of a lone hero who ties her ribbon and resolves to defy her fate.

items.title_es: El héroe de la cinta
items.description_es: Zafiro es la princesa de un reino que ya no existe. Habiendo perdido todo en su tierra natal, Silverland, debido a la calamidad conocida como "Nergal", deambula desesperada hasta que finalmente llega a Goldland. Aunque agobiada por su pasado, comienza a encontrar un rayo de esperanza al encontrarse con la amabilidad de la gente de allí. Pero como para burlarse de su nueva y pacífica vida, la calamidad Nergal aparece una vez más. La misma desesperación que una vez redujo su tierra natal a cenizas ahora amenaza con robarle también la luz a esta tierra. "No volveré a perder nada. Y tampoco dejaré que nadie más pierda nada". Secándose las lágrimas de tristeza, la niña toma su espada. Esta es la historia de un héroe solitario que se ata la cinta y decide desafiar su destino.

items.title: Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to
items.description: Set around the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks displays, this story follows two high school students, Makoto and Akira. Though they live far apart in Tokyo and have never met, their lives are unexpectedly brought together by a single, mysterious painting of a firework. Drawn together by this strange connection, the two grow closer as time runs short. As the festival approaches, Makoto and Akira are faced with a decision that will change their futures forever.

items.description_es: Ambientada en el Gran Espectáculo de Fuegos Artificiales del Festival de Nagaoka, uno de los tres principales espectáculos de fuegos artificiales de Japón, esta historia sigue a dos estudiantes de secundaria, Makoto y Akira. Aunque viven muy separados en Tokio y nunca se han conocido, sus vidas se unen inesperadamente gracias a una única y misteriosa pintura de un fuego artificial. Unidos por esta extraña conexión, los dos se vuelven más cercanos a medida que el tiempo se acaba. A medida que se acerca el festival, Makoto y Akira se enfrentan a una decisión que cambiará su futuro para siempre.
